positions.title: Engineering Associate
positions.description:
Network Software Team
- Created a lightweight process for synchronizing data stores of network device inventories
- Refactored a parallelized test runner for faster and more consistent build times
- Led a team of junior Analysts to implement validations when onboarding network devices
- Led a team of interns extending the functionality of a network observability chat bot
- Responsible as a Tech Lead for contributions to the design and architecture of upcoming project and engineering best practices across the team

positions.title: Engineering Analyst
positions.description:
Network Software Team
- Collaborated to parallelize the automated provisioning process of millions of user firewall rules within the limits of a legacy application written in Node.js
- Partnered with another team to extend automated connectivity to self-service compute
- Aided in organizing an internal hackathon for improving test coverage
- Migrated a legacy database stack to MongoDB
- Updated validations for a bulk network device provisioning process

Franchise Analytics Strategy and Technology (FAST) Team
- Built the basis of a data pipeline using PySpark for trade related communications data for machine learning
- Aided in re-training a machine learning model for parsing trade structures
- Extended a parser for short-hand trade strings based on business requirements

Client Experience Team
- Collaborated in building a full-stack client relationship management (CRM) web application using pseudo-code in Appian
- Assisted with developing a reactive API service using the Java library Vert.x
- Responsible for the end-of-life maintenance of an outreach tracking web application

Risk and Controls Technology Team
- Collaborated on a greenfield project in building a web application using React/Redux for regulatory certifications

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Lock and Alerts Registration Team
- Assisted with QA testing of various user registration flows
- Aided with investigation into methods for user input sanitation
- Expanded unit test coverage for backend processes

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Introduction to Computing (CS 1301) Course
- Held regular weekly office hours working one-on-one with students
- Co-taught a weekly recitation period focused on reviewing course topics, assignments, and exams
- Responsible for grading course assignments and exams, and providing constructive feedback to students
